rites.name: Ilyanae
rites.text: Ilyanae is the concept of the first sounding that condenses the roots of Niranum, a tone held in the hollow before stone had settled. Temples of the Holy Age took it as the pattern by which flame and order were first shaped.

rites.name: Tentalmaeno
rites.text: Tentalmaeno is a concept of Niranum drawn from the Seeding, when the makers plant the Weave and quiet powers sleep under the first sovereign's groves. It names the slow tendrils of growing kingdoms, where roots and rule spread together across the Grounded plains.

rites.name: Ilyeleth
rites.text: Ilyeleth is a concept of Niranum in the Fall, the Sundering and the Shards, the age when worlds broke and the Pact was sworn. It stands for the quiet resolve of those who held the broken pieces together after the old skies cracked.

rites.name: Suratauta
rites.text: Suratauta is a concept in Niranum's Fall, the age when the Sundering broke worlds into Shards and the Pact was sworn among the survivors. It names the vow that held what remained together, and the grief that followed the breaking.

rites.name: Miamuarliel
rites.text: Miamuarliel is a concept of Niranum born in the Fall, when the old bonds between its worlds gave way in the Sundering and the Shards scattered across the sky. It stands as a memory of the Pact sworn in the aftermath, when landfall broke the old ties and the surviving peoples agreed to keep their remaining lands whole.

rites.name: Xaavsasha
rites.text: Xaavsasha is a concept of the Niranum Fall, the moment the Sundering broke the old bonds between worlds and the Shards scattered across the sky. It is remembered as the force that forced the Pact to be sworn among the surviving peoples. Its shape in the record is that of an idea rather than a body, kept alive by those who inherited its promise.
